items.title: Review: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
items.summary: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course.

items.title: Review: Ice Cube on Big3 League: In a Great Position To Scale
items.summary: Ice Cube, CEO & Co-Founder of the Big3 basketball league, says audiences want more basketball in the summer and argues that the league has helped professionalize three-on-three play. He describes basketball as a globally beloved sport and say the league is well positioned to grow, noting that it is already recognized as the world’s premier professional three-on-three league. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Burger King US President on Sales Turnaround
items.summary: Burger King US and Canada President Tom Curtis discussed the chain’s comparable-sales growth, cited in the conversation as 8.4%, against an estimate of 6.2%. Curtis said growth is being driven largely by customers who had stopped visiting and are now returning, drawn by a renewed connection to the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Binance Lost Over $6 Billion in Crypto Hack. Here’s What to Know.
items.summary: Hackers made off with around $6 billion in digital currency in what could be the biggest crypto heist in history. Binance said it will cover the losses.

items.title: Review: These House races could determine which party is in control in the next Congress
items.summary: All 435 seats in the House of Representatives are on the ballot when voters head to the polls on Nov. 3.
